name: search_menu
description: Search the menu by name/description with optional vegan/halal/max_price filters.

name: get_item
description: Full details for one menu item (variants, extras).

name: validate_cart
description: Server-side price + availability check for a cart. Pass an optional coupon_code to preview the server-priced discount (returns discount, coupon_applied, coupon_message, and the discounted total). Store credit is NOT previewed here — it is applied at order time for an identified customer.

name: create_order
description: Place an UNPAID order using one of THIS store's fulfillment modes — the `type` enum lists what this store offers (e.g. takeaway/on-table for a restaurant, ship/pickup_slot/in_store for a shop, pickup_slot/appointment for a service). Omit `type` to use the store's default. Customer pays on arrival or on delivery. Pass an optional coupon_code to apply an owner discount (server-priced; returns discount + coupon_applied). Store credit: only spent when the merchant has enabled agent credit-spend AND the diner is identified by their verified sender phone; the amount used is returned as wallet_applied (server-decided — you cannot force it). Optional scheduled_at ("YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM", store local time) requests a pre-order for later; it is validated against the store's scheduling rules and rejected if invalid.

address.description: Shipping/delivery address, required for ship/delivery modes

scheduled_at.description: Optional pre-order time, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM local

name: order_status
description: Status of an order by its track token.

name: restaurant_info
description: Restaurant name, order types, and payment info.

name: order_history
description: A returning customer's recent orders at this restaurant, matched by their phone number.

name: store_credit_balance
description: A returning customer's store-credit (wallet) balance at this restaurant, matched by phone. Account-bound — safe to read out to a diner who gave their phone. Returns found + balance + currency. Read only: you cannot SPEND credit here — a diner pays with credit on the storefront or customer app.

name: reorder_last
description: Rebuild the customer's most recent order as a cart draft ("the usual"); skips sold-out/removed items. Feed the returned items to validate_cart.

name: order_eta
description: Current estimated prep wait (minutes) based on live kitchen load — use it to set expectations when placing an order.

name: suggest_upsell
description: Recommend up to 3 add-on items for a cart in progress. Returns [{item_id, name, price}] — active, in-stock items from THIS restaurant, cheapest-first, excluding anything already in the cart. Prices are server-sourced (never invent them). Use this AFTER the customer has chosen items, to offer complementary add-ons before checkout; use search_menu instead when the customer is looking for something specific by keyword. Pass the current cart item_ids so they are not re-suggested. Returns an empty array when nothing suitable is available.

cart_item_ids.description: item_ids already in the cart, so they are excluded from suggestions

name: dietary_answer
description: Answer whether ONE menu item satisfies a dietary tag (e.g. vegan, halal, vegetarian, gluten_free), using ONLY the item's structured dietary data. Returns the string "yes", "no", or "unknown". Returns "unknown" when the item has no data for that tag OR the item_id is not found — in that case tell the customer you're not sure and to check with staff; never guess from the name or description. Use this instead of inferring dietary suitability yourself.

tag.description: dietary tag key, e.g. vegan / halal / vegetarian / gluten_free
